$brand.name: monochrome
$brand.description: Editorial monochrome UI with serif headings, square surfaces and controls, visible edges and brisk motion.

accent.$description: Accent foreground — deep gray in light, mid gray in dark; purely neutral, no hue

link.$description: Link color — neutral dark; underline carries the affordance, not hue

linkHover.$description: Hover deepens to near-black in light; lifts to near-white in dark

linkVisited.$description: Visited — mid gray, signal via lightness not hue

highlight.$description: Highlighted text — maximum contrast, editorial emphasis

onColor.$description: Text on colored fills — light in both modes, because background.accent is a dark neutral in both (neutral.800 light / neutral.700 dark). The light variant previously read color.mode.dark, inverting the pairing to 1.42:1.

accent.$description: Accent fill — neutral.800 light (white text ~14:1), neutral.700 dark (white text ~9.5:1); both AA-safe

highlight.$description: Highlight wash — very light gray in light; deep near-black wash in dark

softer.$description: Info softer wash — monochrome re-grounds info to the neutral ramp; lightest gray in light, near-black in dark
Success softer wash — desaturated; gray wash signals without color
Warning softer wash — deliberately desaturated; monochrome suppresses urgency color
Danger softer wash — neutral; monochrome suppresses red tones throughout

focus.$description: Focus border — near-black hairline in light; near-white in dark; high contrast, editorial

accent.$description: Accent border — crisp dark-gray hairline in light; mid-gray in dark

default.$description: Default border — hairline neutral, crisp and minimal

hover.$description: Hover border — slightly darker neutral, no hue shift

light.$description: Light border — barely-visible divider, structural not decorative

active.$description: Active nav label — near-black in light; near-white in dark; maximum legibility, no hue

hover.$description: Nav hover wash — very light gray; subtle without color

active.$description: Active nav item background — slightly deeper gray wash

hover.$description: Nav hover state-layer — tonal gray overlay, subtle and restrained

selected.$description: Nav selected state-layer — slightly deeper gray tonal overlay

pressed.$description: Nav pressed state-layer — deeper gray tonal overlay for tactile feedback

default.$description: Primary action fill — neutral.800 light (~14:1 white), neutral.700 dark (~9.5:1 white); both AA-safe

hover.$description: Hover deepens toward near-black in light; lightens slightly in dark

active.$description: Pressed/active — maximum depth in light; mid-gray in dark (neutral.500 = ~7:1 white, AA-safe)

focus.$description: Focus ring offset on action — slightly lighter for visible offset glow

default.$description: Primary action border — crisp near-black hairline

highlight.$description: Status highlight — neutral signal; no hue, purely lightness-based emphasis

default.$description: Default small control corner; content surfaces and actions have component-specific shape decisions.

near.$description: Near elevation — flat, no shadow; monochrome uses borders not shadows

default.$description: Default elevation — flat; editorial flatness is the identity

far.$description: Far elevation — barely raised when absolutely necessary; never glowing

none.$description: No elevation — perfectly flat, flush with page plane

light.$description: Light card border — hairline structural rule

medium.$description: Medium card border — visible rule, no decorative hue

dark.$description: Dark card border — bold neutral rule, maximum editorial presence

transparent.$description: Transparent card border — no border, minimal

radius.$description: Badge/chip radius (0px) — angular tag, no pill softening

defaultWidth.$description: Input border width — hairline (1px), precise and minimal

defaultStyle.$description: Input border style — solid, no dashes

focusWidth.$description: Input focus border width — thin (1px); focus shown via color contrast not width
Field focus border width — thin (1px); contrast carries the focus signal

easing.$description: Linear easing — direct, no acceleration curve; movement is purposeful not expressive

weight.$description: Regular body weight (400) — neutral, readable, unobtrusive

inset.$description: Compact card variant retains less padding than the default surface.
